name: Etam
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Etam is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah. He is known primarily through his lineage and his children. He is part of the tribe of Judah, which plays a central role in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Etam is mentioned as a descendant of Judah in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles. His children were Jisreel, Jishma and Jidbash.

keyEvents.title: Etam's place in the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Judah, Etam belonged to the lineage that would later lead to King David and the messianic line.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Hur
keyEvents.description: Etam is listed as a son of Hur, who was a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah and a son of Caleb and Ephrath.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Bethlehem
keyEvents.description: Through his father Hur, described as the patriarch of Bethlehem, Etam is linked to the important city of Bethlehem in the territory of Judah.
